This ROI atlas was resampled to the CAT12 1.5x1.5x1.5 mm template resolution, and warped from ICBM to IXI template using DARTEL.

Left-Right ROIs were combined to bilateral ROIs, as ExploreASL divides ROIs in left-right-bilateral automatically. Except for ROIs 113-120 (vermis) and 169-170 (raphe medial and dorsal) which were bilateral already.
Hence:
  1:112 -> 1:56
113:120 -> 57:64
121:168 -> 65:88
169:170 -> 89:90

See /ExploreASL/WorkInProgress/Administration/xASL_adm_AtlasConvert_LeftRight2Bilateral

When using this atlas, please cite: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuroimage.2019.116189.
